Wires Cua Driver into the logged-in graphical session as systemd USER units —
the daemon (`cua-driver serve`) and its MCP endpoint (`cua-driver mcp` behind
supergateway on :3000). The driver cannot run outside the session (it needs
WAYLAND_DISPLAY / XDG_RUNTIME_DIR / the AT-SPI bus), so the units are gated on
graphical-session.target and carry ConditionEnvironment=WAYLAND_DISPLAY. The
desktop account is resolved from uid 1000 at install time, so the candy
composes onto any single-user desktop. Verifiable on the built image: the two
unit files exist and are enabled under graphical-session.target.wants.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | install supergateway (the stdio→Streamable-HTTP MCP bridge the driver-mcp unit runs) — best-effort; the MCP endpoint is optional and the daemon works without it |
| `run` | write the Cua Driver session units (global systemd user units) |
| `run` | enable the units for the desktop user's graphical session (global user units; systemd enables them for every user) |
| `check` | the two Cua Driver session units exist |
| `check` | the driver daemon unit is enabled for graphical-session.target |
| `check` | the units gate on a live Wayland session (the driver cannot run outside it) |
